vu.title: 发票金额与订单应付一致
vu.source_clause: 每张运费发票金额须与对应订单应付金额一致

expected_from.quote: 每张运费发票金额与对应订单应付金额一致

checker.sql: select invoice_id, amount, expect_amount from freight_invoice where batch='2026-10' and abs(amount-expect_amount) > 0.01
checker.scope_sql: select count(*) as n from freight_invoice where batch='2026-10'
